<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

The change adds phase receipts for native C smoke tests and an opt-in CI workflow for cold and warm profiling. The workflow records compiler identities, retains per-case evidence, validates artifacts before reclaiming build trees, and compares the current attempt’s profiles.

### Changes

**Native profiling and CI**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Phase receipts and artifact validation** <br> `crates/rdf-capi/tests/support/phases.rs`|The shared recorder captures command results and build context. It validates Cargo output, selects the matching cdylib, and records file identities. Tests cover parsing, context collection, and receipt failures.|
|**C smoke-test phase recording** <br> `crates/rdf-capi/tests/c_smoke.rs`|The C smoke test records build, compile, link, runtime, and cleanup phases. It validates and identifies generated artifacts, including the projection archive.|
|**Hosted cases, evidence, and reclamation** <br> `crates/rdf-capi/tests/support/hosted.rs`|Hosted support validates case admission and workflow constraints, records case evidence, compares profiles, and guards artifact restoration and build-tree reclamation. Tests exercise these checks.|
|**Profiling command and host prerequisites** <br> `crates/rdf-capi/Cargo.toml`, `crates/rdf-capi/examples/native_ci_profile.rs`, `crates/rdf-capi/tests/native_profile.rs`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`|The example target dispatches profiling operations to support code. Contributor instructions and CI setup specify the writable host directory required by profiling tests.|
|**Opt-in workflow and compiler admission** <br> `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`|The workflow adds a disabled-by-default manual input and records run-attempt-specific Rust and Cargo identities. Profiling requires matching identities and runner setup.|
|**Profile cases and retained evidence** <br> `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`|The workflow runs the before and after cases, uploads their reports, and revalidates each upload before reclaiming private build trees.|
|**Current-attempt profile comparison** <br> `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`|The comparison job restores current-attempt artifacts, validates their inventory and coverage, retains comparison outputs, and requires successful admission and profiling.|

sequenceDiagram
